title: Market Stall

serves.summary: The child runs a market stall: stocks it with what people want in the day's weather, reads which things sold out and brings more of those, and lowers the price of what is not selling and raises the price of the last scarce one, which shows supply and demand, scarcity and sale prices.

request.topic: Supply and demand at a market stall: weather, running out, and prices
request.objective: Predict what people will want on a given day and stock a stall with it; read what sold out and bring more of it; lower the price of what is not selling and raise the price of what is scarce. (SS002-04-A, SS002-04-C, SS002-04-F, SS002-04-I)

params.story: a rainy market day; the child fills the stall's shelf with three things to sell

problems.ask: It is a rainy day at the market. Fill your stall with things people will want to buy.
problems.goal: The umbrella, raincoat and rain boots are on the shelf; nothing for sun or play takes a place.
